source_readme_relevant_lines: - Law and Judgement and all seven Wisdom books, together with all Providence books, are complete at the English editorial/staging stage: 43 Old Testament books. Completed New Testament books at this stage: Matthew, Mark, Luke, John, Acts, Romans, 1 Corinthians, 2 Corinthians, Galatians, Ephesians, Philippians, Colossians, 1 Thessalonians, 2 Thessalonians, 1 Timothy, 2 Timothy, Titus, Philemon, Hebrews, James, 1 Peter, 2 Peter, 1 John, 2 John, 3 John, Jude. Revelation is next; 1 books remain pending the Bespoke pass.

New Testament continuation uses the user-authorized provisional NA28 base (approved 15 October 2026). 26 books have completed the English editorial pass, staging save/readback and reader verification; 1 await that pass. The newer Bespoke PDF recommends UBS6 with ECM support; its complete text has not been obtained. Full UBS6/ECM and apparatus comparison, independent Greek review and human read-aloud review remain pending. Revelation is next. This record does not claim independent scholarly approval.
